subject: Quick demo request — GitHub webhook / self-hosted runner integration
messages:
From: Priyanka Suresh <priyanka@openforge.dev>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: samir@repohealth.ai
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 11:07:00 -0400
Subject: Inquiry: GitHub webhook + self-hosted runner support

Hi Aditya,

We signed up for Redwood last week (trial org: openforge-labs) after reading your docs on integrations. We're primarily evaluating how Redwood would sit between GitHub Actions and our self-hosted runners for faster inference during CI pipelines. A few quick questions before a demo would be great:

- Do you support installation as a GitHub App vs OAuth, and what repo-level permissions are needed?
- Can Redwood receive push/pull_request and workflow_run webhooks and do prefix-based routing?
- We're curious about security posture for private repos and any recommended least-privilege scopes.
- Will a self-hosted runner in our VPC be able to reach Redwood Private, or do we need an outbound proxy?

Would love a short 30m walkthrough focused on integration flow and permissions. We're US-based (PST). Availability this week after 10am PT would work.

Thanks,
Priyanka
Head of Developer Platforms, OpenForge Labs
[Attachment: repo-structure.png (image/png)]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Priyanka Suresh <priyanka@openforge.dev>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 12:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Inquiry: GitHub webhook + self-hosted runner support

Hi Priyanka — thanks for reaching out and welcome! Really glad you found the docs useful.

We can absolutely walk through the integration flow and permissions. Quick options for a 30m slot (all PT):
- Fri 4/23 10:30–11:00am
- Mon 4/26 11:00–11:30am
- Tue 4/27 2:00–2:30pm

If none of those work, tell me a couple of windows and I'll coordinate. For the demo to be productive, could you also attach a short diagram of your repo topology (private/public mix + any org-level webhooks) and, if possible, grant read-only access to one sample repo or share a repository name we can reference?

I've attached a one‑page intake form to capture the technical bits (permissions, firewall egress, runner details) — filling it out will help Marissa (our AE) and Ben (SE) tailor the demo.

Attached: integration-intake-form.pdf

Best,
Aditya Rao
